title: Though all my body has been woven of new stuff time after time
html_source: Though the conceit is a good one, we now know that different body parts regenerate at different rates. Bones, for example, are only fully replaced after several decades, and there are several parts that remain the same (i.e., consist of the selfsame cells) throughout one’s lifespan.
